During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] gas '''mining platform''' was the victim of industrial sabotage, and its officials believed several of the platform's employees to be responsible.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=crewskill|Investigation|Hostile Workplace}}</ref>
